entries.overlap_behavior: d_Phi(A_i, A_j) = 0 iff the windows are identical; decreases as volume of A_i ∩ A_j increases relative to union.
claim_limits: not yet a full metric proof
exact functional form (e.g., Jaccard-style) remains implementation-dependent

usage_rules.name: coupling_strength_rule_v1
usage_rules.statement: The strength of coupling between processes i and j is inversely proportional to the window distance d_Phi(A_i, A_j).

usage_rules.name: boundary_stability_rule_v1
usage_rules.statement: A CSI boundary is stable if the window distance d_Phi to any non-member process remains above a declared exclusion threshold tau_A.
